mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_post_recruitment_member WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.* FROM s_post_recruitment r LEFT JOIN s_post p ON p.id = r.post_id LEFT JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = r.booking_id WHERE r.status IN ('RECRUITING','FULL') AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR p.content_status != 'PUBLISHED' OR b.id IS NULL OR b.status != 'CONFIRMED' OR b.start_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 200

SELECT r.* FROM s_post_recruitment r JOIN s_post p ON p.id = r.post_id WHERE r.status IN ('RECRUITING','FULL') AND ((p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_recruitment_member m WHERE m.recruitment_id = r.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status IN ('APPLIED','APPROVED'))) ORDER BY r.post_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_post_recruitment_member (recruitment_id,user_id,status) VALUES (#{recruitmentId},#{userId},'APPLIED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE applied_at = CASE WHEN status IN ('LEFT','REJECTED','REMOVED') THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE applied_at END, status = CASE WHEN status IN ('LEFT','REJECTED','REMOVED') THEN 'APPLIED' ELSE status END
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_recruitment_member SET status = #{status}, decided_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), reason = #{reason} WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_post_recruitment WHERE post_id = #{postId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM s_post_recruitment WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_post_recruitment (post_id, booking_id, level, level_tag, max_members, fee_mode, aa_amount_fen, description) VALUES (#{recruitment.postId}, #{recruitment.bookingId}, #{recruitment.level}, #{recruitment.levelTag}, #{recruitment.maxMembers}, #{recruitment.feeMode}, #{recruitment.aaAmountFen}, #{recruitment.description})
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_recruitment SET status = #{status}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE s_post_recruitment_member SET status = #{status}, decided_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
